title: Autotune: batching/caching defaults, quantization profiles, and unit-econ tooling
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: reduce per-token cost and operational overhead by providing safe autotuned defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching, shipping curated quantization profiles with fallbacks, and exposing unit-economics tooling for product teams. This PR implements an Autotune service that analyzes historical route traffic and latency to suggest per-route batching and cache defaults; adds a small set of vetted quantization profiles (fp16, int8-conservative, int8-aggressive) with compatibility metadata and runtime fallback logic; introduces a unit-econ CLI and dashboard telemetry to compare cost/latency/quality across profiles; and provides a gradual rollout/migration path via feature flags and canary policies. Changes include runtime integration, config schema, docs and tests. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] canary rollout config, [x] docs updates, [x] perf bench. Related work: ENG-1357 (autotune core), ENG-1420 (uecon dashboard).
